_note: Shrink-only ratchet for the deferred review-finding backlog.
scripts/check_hardening.py re-derives these counts from the registry rows on
every run and requires an EXACT match. Exact rather than a ceiling, in both
- A count ABOVE the ratchet is a regression; the gate reds.
- A count BELOW it means work landed and the bookkeeping did not; the gate
also reds, so closing a finding and lowering this file are one change.
That is what keeps the number honest. Nothing here is trusted — it is a claim
checked against the rows every run, and git history shows every time it moved.
Lowering it is the visible unit of progress on this campaign; raising it needs
a stated reason in the commit message.
